summary: Frontend-only verification of the black-screen crash fix on Lead-Generation.ca preview. All targeted flows pass: (1) Site loads and stays rendered at desktop (1920px) and mobile (435px) with substantial body text (~5425 chars) and no uncaught console errors or pageerrors across full scroll of all sections; (2) ErrorBoundary is NOT visible on normal load (data-testid='error-boundary' count = 0), confirming defensive guards on avail.days work and the wrapper only activates on real errors; (3) BookingCalendar renders 4 day buttons (Thu 30 Jul, Fri 31 Jul, Mon 03 Aug, Tue 04 Aug) with 3 slots each (slot-10:00 / slot-14:00 / slot-16:00). Selecting a day + slot shows booking-selection-summary. Completed ONE real test booking (TEST_User_* / TEST_Co / Roofing industry) — Confirm returned booking-success ('YOU'RE BOOKED — Thursday, July 30 at 10:00 AM (EDT)'); (4) All three testimonial cards (Stephen Cruey/Loom, Clint Roberts/mp4, Emilio Talavera/Vimeo) open testimonial-modal with testimonial-video player element loaded, no console errors; (5) All primary CTAs verified to scroll to #apply — header-cta-button, hero-primary-cta, sticky-cta-button, footer-cta-button all bring booking-section into viewport. Zero console errors and zero pageerrors captured during the full test run.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingCalendar guards look correct (Array.isArray on data?.days, guarded .find/.map). Consider also logging a warning to Sentry/console when the availability response is not shaped as expected — silent fallback to empty days hides misconfigured deploys where /api is served the SPA.
ErrorBoundary should ideally include a small 'Reload' CTA (if not already present) so a caught runtime error still gives users a recovery path.
Radix Select for industry (booking-service) does not accept .fill() — that's expected Radix behavior; documented for future test agents.
test_credentials: N/A - public landing page, no auth
seed_data_creation: Created 1 real booking on backend (per request cap of ONE): TEST_User_<timestamp> for Thursday, July 30, 10:00 AM EDT. This slot will now be unavailable to future testers, as expected. If needed, delete via the bookings collection in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://cherry-tree-agency.preview.emergentagent.com. Black-screen bug is FIXED. Booking form's booking-service is a Radix Select combobox — click it then click a [role='option'] (do NOT use .fill()). Testimonial modals do not close on Escape reliably in scripts; click the DialogClose (X) button inside [data-testid='testimonial-modal']. One TEST_User booking already exists on 30 Jul 10:00 EDT — pick another slot/day. Booking section id='apply'.
rca of the issue: Previously reported crash root cause (per E1): production /api requests returned the SPA index.html (HTTP 200 HTML) on a frontend-only deploy, so availability response lacked a 'days' array, and code called avail.days.find(...) on undefined -> uncaught TypeError -> React unmount -> black screen. Fix: BookingCalendar defensively coerces days to [] via Array.isArray(data?.days) and guards all .find/.map calls; app is wrapped in an ErrorBoundary so any future runtime error renders a fallback instead of a blank body. Verified in this iteration: no TypeError, days array renders 4 items even from the live /api response, ErrorBoundary is not triggered on happy path.
